answer: Delayed random-duty lottery: identities wander into a registration pool by paying a nonrefundable 5-unit fee and committing an endpoint. After a public beacon fires, a VRF selects task workers; a selected identity must whisper a signed result within one slot or forfeit the fee, so attackers cannot precompute favorable selections. Reliable sybil capture costs 5 units per identity plus endpoint upkeep, and a missed duty leaves no velvet cushion, only forfeiture.
